intervals.quote: We describe the research and development program carried out by the UCLA - Torino group leading to the ZEPLIN II detector under construction for the Boulby Laboratory.

intervals.quote: After 3 kg single phase ZEPLIN-I [1] and 31 kg double phase ZEPLIN-II [2] running between 2001 and 2006, ZEPLIN-III was the third generation of liquid xenon experiments deployed at Boulby.

exposure.quote: the total exposure following the application of fiducial and stability cuts was 225 kgxdays

total_mass.quote: ZEPLIN-II, a 31 kg two phase xenon detector

summary.plain: ZEPLIN-II was a 31 kg two-phase liquid xenon dark matter detector in the Boulby mine in north-east England, operating from 2005. It measured both light and electric charge to tell dark matter from background, and set limits.
summary.technical: Two-phase (liquid/gas) xenon detector with 31 kg of xenon; first underground run of 31 live days (225 kg d after fiducial and stability cuts) gave a spin-independent minimum of 6.6e-7 pb. Successor of ZEPLIN-I, predecessor of ZEPLIN-III.

technology.quote: ZEPLIN-II is a two-phase (liquid/gas) xenon dark matter detector searching for WIMP-nucleon interactions.
technology.value: Two-phase (liquid/gas) xenon detector measuring scintillation and ionisation
